frozen_before_execution: 2026-09-19, before rendering source-relocation cases or running the proposed joint mapper

hidden_corner_four_sources.description: Only the true ceiling has a first-order echo; unobserved corner parent planes are not required. No equivalent diagonal phantom plane may be definitive.

comparison: Equal raw recordings and extracted observations for the joint mapper, a joint direct-plane-grid competitor if implemented, and independent single-source consensus baseline. No truth, parent path labels, image sources or laser answers enter any fitting method.
shared_uncertainty: One common speed/source-clock scale and shared receiver survey errors across source placements; repeated captures cannot be treated as independent new receiver calibrations. Report covariance behavior and fit sensitivity.
physical_limit: Moving source along the corner intersection line leaves the equivalent diagonal reflector invariant. Repeating a source pose adds no discrimination. General higher-order uniqueness is not established by these finite examples.
policy: Preserve every failure. Do not run these held-out seeds until the new joint mapper is ready at an immutable checkpoint. Use only development seeds for implementation tuning. Existing frozen stress/FLAIR criteria are unchanged.
